summary: Mingteng International Corp Inc. filed a Form 6-K reporting the termination of its at-the-market (ATM) equity facility with AC Sunshine Securities LLC. The company had issued 222,568,877 Class A ordinary shares under the Sales Agreement for gross proceeds of ~US$20.6 million, netting ~US$18.0 million after a 3.5% commission. As of June 8, 2026, the ATM was terminated and the company has 5,028,406 Class A ordinary shares outstanding. Proceeds are earmarked for working capital, business development, and capital expenditures. This filing is a routine update on a terminated shelf takedown, not a special situation.
